data: Amazon (AMZN) grew revenue in fiscal 2022 even as profitability deteriorated sharply. Revenue rose 9.4% to $514.0 billion in fiscal 2022 from $469.8 billion in fiscal 2021. Gross profit climbed to $225.2 billion from $197.5 billion, for a fiscal 2022 gross margin of 43.8%. The weakness sat further down the income statement. Operating income fell to $12.2 billion in fiscal 2022 from $24.9 billion in fiscal 2021, leaving a fiscal 2022 operating margin of just 2.4%. Net income swung to a loss of $2.7 billion in fiscal 2022 from a profit of $33.4 billion in fiscal 2021, a decline of 108.2%. Diluted EPS moved to -$0.27 in fiscal 2022 from $3.24 in fiscal 2021. The key question for investors is whether Amazon can turn continued revenue growth and solid gross profit into a recovery in operating earnings.
